name: PD 135 was established by Ordinance No. 17272, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 27, 1982. Ordinance No. 17272 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 17272 was amended by Ordinance No. 17319, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 10, 1982; Ordinance No. 18219, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 11, 1984; Ordinance No. 21493, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 9, 1992; and Ordinance No. 24286, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 14, 2000. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17272; 17319; 18219; 21493; 24286; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 135 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-135.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 135 was established by Ordinance No. 17272, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 27, 1982. Ordinance No. 17272 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 17272 was amended by Ordinance No. 17319, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 10, 1982; Ordinance No. 18219, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 11, 1984; Ordinance No. 21493, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 9, 1992; and Ordinance No. 24286, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 14, 2000. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17272; 17319; 18219; 21493; 24286; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-135.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 135 is established on property generally located on the northeast corner of R.L. Thornton Freeway and Gurley Avenue. The size of PD 135 is approximately 5.8614 acres. (Ord. Nos. 17272; 17319; 25508; 27678)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-135.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-135.104.CONCEPTUAL PLAN. A conceptual plan as approved by the city council is provided as Exhibit 135A. (Ord. Nos. 17272; 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan And Landscape Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-135.105.DEVELOPMENT PLAN AND LANDSCAPE PLAN. Prior to the issuance of a building permit within this PD, a detailed development plan (Exhibit 135B) and a landscape plan (Exhibit 135C), in accordance with the conceptual plan for each phase of development, must be approved by the city plan commission. (Ord. Nos. 17272; 24286; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-135.106.USES.
(a)Tract A may be used for all uses permitted under the O-2 Office-2 District, except for hotel, motel, or drive-in banking uses;
(b)Tract B may be used for all uses permitted under the O-2 Office-2 District except for hotel or motel uses; and
(c)Tract C may be used for a commercial parking lot or garage, off-street parking for uses outside the PD, and for all uses permitted under the O-2 Office-2 District except for hotel or motel uses. (Ord. Nos. 17272; 25508)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-135.107.HEIGHT. Maximum height of any building, as calculated by the Dallas Development Code, must not exceed 36 feet on Tract A, 72 feet on Tract B, and 120 feet on Tract C. (Ord. Nos. 17272; 21493; 25508)

sections.title: Floor Area Ratio
sections.text: SEC. 51P-135.108.FLOOR AREA RATIO. Floor area ratio on the combined total of Tracts A, B, and C may not exceed 1.5 to 1. (Ord. Nos. 17272; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-135.109.PARKING. Parking must be provided as required by the Dallas Development Code. Parking for any permitted uses on Tract B may be provided on Tracts A, B, or C. (Ord. Nos. 17272; 25508)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-135.110.SETBACKS. Setbacks must be established in compliance with the O-2 Office-2 District standards or a maximum of 50 feet, whichever is less. The Tract lines may not be considered to be lot lines. (Ord. Nos. 17272; 25508)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text: SEC. 51P-135.111.SCREENING. All off-street parking fronting onto Gurley Avenue must be screened with one or a combination of the following to a minimum three feet in height: solid wall, earthen berm, or evergreen landscape materials. (Ord. Nos. 17272; 25508)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text: SEC. 51P-135.112.LANDSCAPING. A landscape plan must be submitted for approval as part of each development plan. All landscaping must be maintained in a healthy growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 17272; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-135.113.SIGNS. Signs located between Gurley Avenue and Philip Avenue that are within 200 feet of the north line of East R.L. Thornton Freeway, measured from a point along a straight line that runs along or adjacent to the north line, as shown on the conceptual plan, must comply with the sign provisions for business zoning districts contained in the Dallas Development Code, except that non-premise signs are prohibited. All other signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 17272; 21493; 25508)

sections.title: Additional Development Standards
sections.text: SEC. 51P-135.114.ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS. Development must be in compliance with the O-2 Office-2 District standards except as otherwise indicated in this article. (Ord. Nos. 17272; 25508)

sections.title: Streets And Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-135.115.STREETS AND PAVING. All streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must be constructed to the requirements of the department of public works and transportation and other departments of the city. (Ord. Nos. 17272; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-135.116.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)Development and utilization of the Property must be in compliance with all applicable statutes, codes, and requirements of the city.
(b)The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.
(c)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 17272; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-135.117.ZONING MAP. PD 135 is located on Zoning Map No. J-8. (Ord Nos. 17272; 25508)
